question: Will UNI reach $5 during the first week of September (Sep 1–7, 2026 UTC)?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the UNI/USDT price on Binance reaches or exceeds $5.00 at any point during the first week of September 2026 (September 1–7, 2026 UTC), as observed at the market's settlement time or via the highest price recorded during that window.
- "No": Wins if the UNI/USDT price on Binance does not reach $5.00 at any point during September 1–7, 2026 UTC, meaning the highest price observed during that window remains below $5.00.

Clarifications:
- "First week of September" is defined as September 1, 2026 00:00 UTC through September 7, 2026 23:59 UTC, inclusive.
- The price used is UNI/USDT on Binance spot; the threshold is met if the price trades at or above $5.00 at any single moment within the defined window.
